independence.method: Read-only code audit plus independent standard-library recomputation. The ZIP and pickle recomputations did not import the target script. The released test pickle population was reconstructed with a custom stack machine over pickletools.genops and did not call pickle.Unpickler.

released train, validation, and test pickle identities
released test pickle opcode and population inspection

population keys, physical-event grouping, agent roles, semantic dry-run boundaries, 90-key alignment, dates, provenance wording, controls, kill criteria, stdout, certificate, and hashes
excluded: scores, rankings, acceptance rules, paper-table effects, and benchmark performance
actual converter execution or generated-index comparison
full-release coverage outside the supplied mini/test population

findings.finding: The partial ZIP fully covers the official central-directory test population.
findings.evidence: The live official EOCD and central directory contain 2002 entries and exactly match the supplied inventory. All 336 mini/test entries end by byte 474709319, below the 875724800-byte prefix, and all 336 independently pass local-header, length, decompression, remote-central CRC32, and certificate SHA-256 checks.
findings.claimEffect: The supplied prefix is sufficient for mini/test population and source-member analysis, but not for full-archive claims.

findings.finding: The 336 SHA-256 values are real local recomputations but are not 336 upstream-published SHA attestations.
findings.evidence: The official central directory publishes CRC32 and sizes; the official endpoint publishes one full-archive SHA-256. The fresh remote 875724800-byte prefix stream hash did not complete.
findings.claimEffect: Say locally SHA-256-identified and official-central-directory CRC-verified. Do not say the official source published or independently attested all 336 member SHA-256 values.

findings.finding: No arbitrary-code opcode is executable for the supplied test pickle under the frozen allowlist and deny-all class lookup.
findings.evidence: Independent opcode inspection found only 17 primitive/container opcodes, no dangerous constructor or persistence opcode, one STOP at the final byte, and no trailing data. A separate nonexecuting stack machine reconstructed the payload.
findings.claimEffect: Supports safe bounded inspection of this supplied pickle, not a general safe-pickle or denial-of-service-resistance claim.

findings.finding: The released population has 30 physical events and four receiver-conditioned rows per event, with agent 0 as an additional released ego.
findings.evidence: Independent decoding found 120 unique scenario/timestamp/ego keys, 30 exact scenario/timestamp groups, 30 rows for each agent, the same four source PCDs within each event, and the other three agents as cooperators for every row.
findings.claimEffect: Supports treating the four rows as projections of one physical event rather than four independent acquisitions.

findings.finding: The 90-row dry-run is faithful to the observed converter population-selection filters but is not converter execution.
findings.evidence: AST confirms scenario/timestamp grouping, literal candidates 1/2/3, the eligibility guard, one append in the eligible loop, and a test invocation. Every observed test YAML/pose/PCD needed by that population path is present. Converter imports, unsafe YAML loading, transformations, annotations, dump, and output comparison were not executed.
findings.claimEffect: The label population-selection semantic dry-run is accurate. Actual execution, regeneration parity, and payload parity remain blocked.

findings.finding: The vehicle-ego 90-key alignment has no observed sorting or floating-point alias.

findings.claimEffect: Supports exact key alignment for this mini/test input only.

findings.finding: The date evidence is descriptive and cannot establish generator lineage.
findings.evidence: The test pickle ZIP member date is earlier on the calendar than the first public converter commit, but the member timezone is absent. HTTP Last-Modified describes the served archive object, and commit dates describe public source history.
findings.claimEffect: The certificate's explicit non-attribution caveat is necessary. Any historical generator claim is blocked.

findings.finding: Two of four negative controls are self-confirming consistency expressions rather than executed negative controls.

findings.claimEffect: The controls cannot independently prove the conclusion. They should be relabeled or replaced before being cited as falsification evidence.

findings.finding: Stdout, certificate bytes, and recorded script hash are consistent.

verdict.summary: The core mini/test population finding is independently reproducible: 120 released rows form 30 four-agent physical events, and the exact 90 vehicle-ego keys align with the fixed public converter's statically audited population path while 30 agent-0 ego rows remain release-only. The certificate is honest that the converter was not executed.
blockers: no actual converter execution or produced-index comparison
no upstream per-member SHA-256 attestation or completed fresh remote prefix digest
negative controls are not an independent falsification suite
verdict.methodologyDisposition: Retain only the bounded population-selection and key-difference claims with the stated boundaries. Block regeneration parity, generator lineage, general pickle safety, full-release, and any score or acceptance inference.
